study: M8 pre-existing online score-estimator rate agreement for Crown AH side selection; historical event-time only

methodology.features: Two pre-existing online attack/defense score-only rate configurations, learning rates 0.025 and 0.06; use only events at least two UTC calendar days earlier, same target FID joined to Crown AH T1 source-event line/odds/FT.
methodology.decision: For each model choose the side with the larger independent-Poisson expected AH net return at actual Crown line and odds; test each rate separately and place the same side only when both choose it. A disagreement is no bet. No threshold search.
methodology.poisson_tail: Goals 0..24 with probabilities renormalized; tail probability is numerically negligible for observed rates. Quarter lines are split into two half stakes.
methodology.time_forward: Forecasts are precomputed online without target match score; target reporting uses Crown local/Beijing year. Historical features have no first-received timestamp.
methodology.selection_note: The model family and target years were previously studied; this agreement policy is a retrospective diagnostic, not an unseen test.
methodology.receipt_note: Crown actual HTTP receipt archive is only used for FID intersection. Historical score features have no verified as-received snapshots; no valid live feature replay is claimed.
